name: PDC Aging Summary
query: SELECT customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180", SUM(CASE WHEN reference_date >= CURDATE() THEN amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS "Not Due:Currency:120", SUM(CASE WHEN reference_date < CURDATE() AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), reference_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS "0-7 Days:Currency:120", SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), reference_date) BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS "8-30 Days:Currency:120", SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), reference_date) > 30 THEN amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS "30+ Days:Currency:120", SUM(amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0)) AS "Total Open:Currency:130" FROM `tabPDC` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND pdc_status NOT IN ('Cleared', 'Bounced', 'Partially Bounced') GROUP BY customer ORDER BY `Total Open:Currency:130` DESC
